Classification: Low Clan (Usurpers)

In 1022, eight Hermetic magi led by @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} completed a ritual meant to grant true immortality; instead it damned them as vampires through theft of the Blood of Caine, specifically the blood and dominion of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} Antediluvian Saulot (whose destruction the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} have never officially admitted to). Their House was banished from the Hermetic Order's rolls in 1202, dooming its remaining mortal members to Embrace or execution, and the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} have fought their @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} enemies to a standstill ever since. Now led by "the Seven" (with internal factions under Goratrix the Sleepless, Etrius the Reluctant, and Meerlinda), House Tremere seeks legitimacy and a place at the Cainite table despite near-universal distrust — even from Cainites who don't hate them consider them unclean.

Disciplines: Auspex, Dominate, Thaumaturgy

Advantage: All Tremere gain one Occult Ability and one Occult Influence.

Disadvantage: At the Embrace every Tremere drinks from a chalice of the blood of seven clan elders, taking one step toward a blood bond to the elders — and through them, to the clan.

Organization: A tightly hierarchical Pyramid structure centered on chantries, with the High Chantry of Ceoris as its seat of power.

Suggested Viae: Humanity, Sin. Many Tremere are unaware there are alternatives.
